hook: The lie was terrible until his foot got involved.
setting: In long rough grass off the fairway, thick blades up around the babies.
action: Mulligan nudges his ball to a better spot with one foot, Birdie calls him out, Mulligan defends himself deadpan.
sound: rustling rough grass, birdsong, a grunt of effort
judge: 'I crawled it over' cleverly uses babyhood with a sharp improvement twist.
